mechanisms_outside_ir.mechanism: Infilling (FIM) tokenizer extension: four special tokens added to the Llama 2 tokenizer for the 7B/13B/70B models (training format, not a layer change)
mechanisms_outside_ir.quote: We extend \llamavtwo's tokenizer with four special tokens that mark the beginning of the prefix, the middle part or the suffix, and the end of the infilling span.

output.notes: Described the base Code Llama (released, long-context fine-tuned) models. The architecture is not restated; the paper says all models are initialized from Llama 2 weights. On that basis I marked these values as inherited from Llama 2: sizes, RMSNorm, pre-norm, SwiGLU, no biases, untied head and GQA for 34B/70B. Positional encoding (RoPE, block-diagonal 2x2 i.e. interleaved pairs) and theta=1e6 are stated. Block-op attributes are given for the 7B config. Vocab size is left not_stated for 7B/13B/70B because those models add four FIM special tokens to Llama 2's tokenizer and the paper gives no final count; 34B (no infilling) inherits the Llama 2 tokenizer. Context length is the 16384 LCFT sequence length; initial code training used 4096.
